experiment.hypothesis: A can map its persisted ordinal intent assessment into the existing bounded Strategy.retrieval_depth field so narrow high-confidence Buying retrieves fewer candidates without teaching B a second confidence policy.

policy.fixed_fallback: When IntentAssessment is unavailable or the adaptive gate is false, preserve the prior intent-and-active-constraint mapping.
policy.B_consumption: B reads only the validated bounded request.strategy.retrieval_depth value; raw IntentAssessment and confidence do not cross the seam.
policy.calibration_boundary: IntentAssessment confidence remains an A-owned ordinal stability band, not a calibrated probability.

evaluation_boundary.offline_target_use: Development-only metric and session comparison; no evaluator field crossed SessionState, Strategy, RetrievalRequest, diagnostics, retrieval, or ranking.

cost.timing_interpretation: Candidate-count reduction is deterministic. Latency and RSS are separate single-process runs and are directional observations, not controlled causal estimates.

verification.red_test: High-confidence narrow Buying returned depth 80 before the candidate and expected 60.
targeted_properties: A owns the confidence-band decision and B consumes only Strategy.retrieval_depth
the adaptive rule requires Buying, high ordinal confidence, and at least two active constraints
effective depth remains max(top_k, selected floor)
medium confidence and missing IntentAssessment preserve the prior fixed mapping
the free-form Strategy reason records adaptive_narrow but is not a B-side gate

decision_rationale: All aggregate quality metrics improved and one Development session gained a hit while none lost a hit.
Mean lexical and structured candidate depth fell by 6.150415 candidates per executed retrieval response.
Fold 1 has a small disclosed MRR and TechnicalScore regression, folds 2 and 3 are exact parity, and fold 4 improves materially.
The gain is concentrated in three sessions and should not be described as universal fold improvement.
The policy preserves A/B ownership, uses the existing bounded Strategy field, and has an exact legacy fallback.
